32:     return rb;
33: }
34: 
35: void rb_destroy(ringbuf_t *rb)
36: {

38:         return;
39:     free(rb->storage);
40:     free(rb);
41: }

48: }

55: }

60:         return;
61:     rb->length = 0;
62:     rb->head   = 0;
63:     rb->tail   = 0;
64: }
65: 
66: static inline void advance(ringbuf_t *rb, size_t *pos)
67: {
68:     (*pos)++;
69:     if (*pos == rb->capacity)
70:         *pos = 0;
71: }
72: 
73: size_t rb_write(ringbuf_t *rb, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
74: {
75:     if (!rb || !data || len == 0)
76:         return 0;
77: 
78:     if (rb->length == rb->capacity)
79:         return 0;
80: 
81:     /* How much can we write? */
82:     size_t avail = rb->capacity - rb->length;
83:     if (len > avail)
84:         len = avail;
85: 
86:     size_t written = len;
87: 
88:     /* First segment: from head to end of storage */
89:     size_t first = rb->capacity - rb->head;
90:     if (first < len) {
91:         memcpy(rb->storage + rb->head, data, first);
92:         advance(rb, &rb->head);
93:         data += first;
94:         len  -= first;
95:     } else {
96:         memcpy(rb->storage + rb->head, data, len);
97:         rb->head = (rb->head + len) % rb->capacity;
98:     }
99: 
100:     rb->length += written;
101:     return written;
102: }

104: size_t rb_read(ringbuf_t *rb, uint8_t *out, size_t len)
105: {
106:     if (!rb || !out || len == 0)
107:         return 0;
108: 
109:     if (rb->length == 0)
110:         return 0;
111: 
112:     size_t avail = rb->length;
113:     if (len > avail)
114:         len = avail;
115: 
116:     /* First segment: from tail to end of storage */
117:     size_t first = rb->capacity - rb->tail;
118:     if (first < len) {
119:         memcpy(out, rb->storage + rb->tail, first);
120:         out += first;
121:         rb->tail += first;
122:         rb->length -= first;
123: 
124:         /* Wrap-around: second segment */
125:         second:
126:         rb->tail = 0;   /* restart at beginning after wrapping */
127:     } else {
128:         memcpy(out, rb->storage + rb->tail, len);
129:         rb->tail += len;
130:         if (rb->tail == rb->capacity)
131:             rb->tail = 0;
132:         rb->length -= len;
133:     }
134: 
135:     return len;
136: }
137:

139: {
140:     if (!rb || !out || len == 0)
141:         return 0;
142: 
143:     if (rb->length == 0)
144:         return 0;
145: 
146:     if (len > rb->length)
147:         len = rb->length;
148: 
149:     /* Copy by advancing a local copy of tail without mutating state */
150:     size_t pos = rb->tail;
151:     for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
152:         out[i] = rb->storage[pos];
153:         pos++;
154:         if (pos == rb->capacity)
155:             pos = 0;
156:     }
157:
